supersedes.reason: It was untracked (.gitignore ignores .claude/), so no clean checkout could read it, and three of its provenance claims were false. Corrected below, each against a command whose output is quoted.

provenance.model: continuous history, not a parentless re-root

head.verify: git rev-parse HEAD && git rev-list --count HEAD && git ls-files | wc -l

brandCutoverCommit.subject: chore: initialize TokenProxy 0.1.0
brandCutoverCommit.verify: git cat-file -p f6bb8f79 | awk '/^parent/{print $2;exit}' && git merge-base --is-ancestor 90b52e06 HEAD && echo PARENT_REACHABLE

corrections.evidence: The claimed sha names a real commit object but 'git merge-base --is-ancestor 8c8220f3 HEAD' reports NOT_REACHABLE, so it is not on this history at all. It is a dangling object from a discarded attempt, retained only by the reflog (16 entries).

corrections.claimed: 0, with 'no predecessor commit, tag, or object reachable from this history'
corrections.actual: The brand cutover is a normal child commit. f6bb8f79 has parent 90b52e06, and both are reachable from HEAD. The history carries 1148 commits back to 3857598de4ef88bda862314f6cbc89e37280de3e.
corrections.evidence: git merge-base --is-ancestor f6bb8f79 HEAD -> reachable; git merge-base --is-ancestor 90b52e06 HEAD -> reachable

node -p "require('./package.json').version". The cutover commit subject also says 0.1.0 and is likewise wrong about the version it shipped; the subject is immutable history and is not rewritten, it is corrected here.

predecessorRelationship.claim: This repository is a renamed continuation of its predecessor's source history, not an independent re-root. The predecessor product name is retired from every shipped surface; its COMMITS remain in the history because rewriting 1148 commits to erase a name buys nothing the residual scan does not already guarantee about what ships.
predecessorRelationship.remotes: one, origin, pointing at this repository. No predecessor remote is configured.

residualScan.scope: 8 hits, all under .claude/execution-packet/ and README.md. .claude/ is gitignored so none of it ships; the README hit is the deliberate one-line statement of what this product was renamed from.
residualScan.invariant: A legacy name in any TRACKED file counts. The exemptions cover only paths git is configured to ignore.
